found_leak.what: In the first run, check-in history plus earlier PHQ-2 answers scored above 0.90.
found_leak.cause: "Last week's PHQ-2" was taken from last week's label, whose window runs Thursday to Wednesday. So it could be a different answer given on Monday to Wednesday of this week, one to three days before this week's answer, with a recall period that overlaps it almost fully.
found_leak.fix: Use only PHQ-2 answers dated before Monday of this week, the same rule as the check-in.

leak_demos.name: Anxiety items from the label's own survey
leak_demos.cause: PHQ-4 items 1 and 2 are answered on the same screen, seconds before the two items that make the label.
leak_demos.fix: Use only answers from earlier weeks (framing 5).

leak_demos.name: The PHQ-4 total from the label's own survey
leak_demos.cause: The PHQ-4 total contains the two PHQ-2 items, so it is the label plus noise.
leak_demos.fix: Never use a score that contains the label items.

leak_demos.name: Each student's average PHQ-2 over all their weeks
leak_demos.cause: The average includes this week's answer and every later answer.
leak_demos.fix: Average only the answers from earlier weeks.

leak_demos.name: Weeks split at random, so each student sits in train and test
leak_demos.cause: The model learns each student's usual phone pattern and their usual mood, then meets the same student again.

leak_demos.name: Random week split, with check-ins and earlier PHQ-2 answers as features
leak_demos.cause: Same as above, with mood answers added. The model meets students it already knows.

leak_demos.name: z-scores normalised with the student's future weeks
leak_demos.cause: Each week is compared with a mean and spread that include later weeks.
leak_demos.fix: Use only earlier weeks for the mean and spread.

leak_demos.name: Depresjon days split at random
leak_demos.cause: Days from the same person land in train and test, so the model recognises the person.

fixed.model: Per day, split by person: Random forest

student_split.what: Every cross-validation fold is checked in code: no student is in both the training and the test part.

past_only_features.what: Every week after a cut-off was replaced with noise. The z-scores and last-week values up to the cut-off did not change.

checkin_before_label.what: The latest check-in answer used for a week is always from an earlier day than that week's PHQ-2 answer, and never from the same survey.

earlier_phq2_before_monday.what: Every earlier PHQ-2 answer used as a feature is dated before Monday of the week, so at least 4 days before the label answer. PHQ-2 asks about the last two weeks, so the baseline is also scored on pairs 14 or more days apart.

label_shuffle.what: The same pipeline run on shuffled labels must score near 0.5: within 0.47 to 0.53 on the Dartmouth framings, and with 0.5 inside the 95% interval on the small external samples.

phone_before_answer.what: In framings 1b, 2, 4 and 5 every phone day used, including the personal baseline weeks and the eligibility count, is dated strictly before the PHQ-2 answer.

personal_14_day_separation.what: In the personal models every test answer comes 14 or more days after the last training answer, by actual answer dates.

separated_inputs_before_recall_window.what: In framing 5b every PHQ-2 and check-in input is dated 14 or more days before the answer, so it shares no day with the two weeks the answer describes.

no_self_report_in_passive.what: Every passive feature set is checked in code for PHQ, label, check-in or history columns.

transforms_inside_folds.what: Scaling, imputation and every model are fit on the training part of each fold only. Personal z-scores use only the student's earlier weeks.
